decisions.rationale: All 219 comparators were reviewed. PF-0172, PF-0201, and PF-0215 concern blocked-episode mapping, target binding, or action identifiers, but none shares the Graph request identity boundary and its missing lossless mapping across episode, scope, target, and snapshot.
